root_cause.text: The hns3 VF driver allocates `kinfo->tqp` and initializes `hdev->htqp` using `kinfo->num_tqps` instead of `hdev->num_tqps`, which can be smaller, leaving some elements of the `hdev->htqp` array uninitialized.
root_cause.evidence: In `hclgevf_knic_setup()`, the patch changes the allocation size of `kinfo->tqp` and the loop boundary for initializing `hdev->htqp[i]` from `kinfo->num_tqps` to `hdev->num_tqps` because `kinfo->num_tqps` is set to `min(new_tqps, hdev->num_tqps)` and can be smaller than `hdev->num_tqps`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix an out-of-bounds write in hclgevf_knic_setup by allocating the queue pointer array using the hardware maximum TQP count instead of the active TQP count.
intent_record.what: Replaced kinfo->num_tqps with hdev->num_tqps in both the devm_kcalloc allocation size and the loop limit.
intent_record.how: This ensures that the kinfo->tqp array is allocated with enough space to accommodate all hdev->num_tqps elements, preventing an out-of-bounds write during initialization.
